The Ann–Ben block is fixed as a consecutive pair, with Cara before Elif before Ann before Hana, and Gus at least three slots after Ann. The only placement that also keeps Dev at least three from Ann, Ben, Cara, and Gus, with Dev before Gus, is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7. That forces Gus into 9 and Hana into 8.

The first five slots are then forced: Dev in 1 (the only seat far enough from both Cara and Ann), Finn in 2 (at least three from both Ben and Elif), Ivo in 3 (at least three from Ben, and before Gus), Cara in 4, Elif in 5. Elif in 5 is exactly three from Finn in 2, so Finn cannot move to 3. Every listed constraint holds, and every other Ann–Ben position breaks an order or distance rule.
